solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Run away from odd young woman

indicators.note: taking the run away from the word means its letter is removed

parts.note: droll means odd or quaintly amusing
R is the cricket scoring abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Someone flees from a peculiar girl.
explanation.definitionFit: Doll is informal, rather dated slang for an attractive girl or young woman.

clue.text: Reckless Valerie died, deserted (and) abandoned

parts.note: D is the abbreviation for deserted, used in military records

indicators.note: abandoned means wild and unrestrained, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Valerie behaved rashly, died alone and forsaken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Abandoned' looks like more of the story but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A daredevil person is recklessly bold, so as an adjective it means reckless.

clue.text: Golfer reported weariness

indicators.note: reported means as said aloud, so it is a sound-alike

parts.note: Bernhard Langer is a German champion golfer

explanation.surface: A golfer was said to be tired.
explanation.definitionFit: Languor is a feeling of tiredness or listlessness, a close synonym for weariness.

clue.text: Mate stores most of his in a small bottle

indicators.note: a friend who stores something holds it inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a mate is a pal, a friend

indicators.note: most of the word means all but its final letter is kept

explanation.surface: A friend keeps most of a man's belongings inside a tiny bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: A phial is a small glass vial for medicine or perfume, a synonym for a small bottle.

clue.text: Early flowering lavender, reduced by a penny, is replanted below edges of pier

indicators.note: in a down clue, below means this piece comes after the other
the edges of the word pier are its first and last letters
the word lavender is reduced by having the penny's letter taken away
replanted means set again in a new arrangement, so the letters are shuffled

parts.note: D stands for a penny, from the Latin denarius in old British money

explanation.surface: Instructions for moving lavender plants below a jetty.
explanation.walkthrough: LAVENDER minus D (old penny) gives LAVENER, which 'is replanted' to EVERNAL, below P and R.
explanation.definitionFit: Prevernal describes plants flowering before spring, hence early flowering.

clue.text: Set in authority Independent politician does badly

parts.note: an MP is a Member of Parliament

indicators.note: something done badly is botched, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: In a seat of power, a non-party politician performs poorly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something imposed is laid down by someone in authority, so it is set by authority.

clue.text: Sweeping Libya's capital, Royal Artillery turns up — Gaddafi's original regime's ending

indicators.note: a word's capital is its first letter, here the start of the word Libya
in a down clue, turns up means the letters are read upwards, in reverse

parts.note: the original, or first, letter of the name Gaddafi

indicators.note: ending means the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Sweeping across the Libyan capital, the gunners emerge and Gaddafi's regime is finished.
explanation.definitionFit: Large in the sense of broad and wide-ranging, as in large changes, matches sweeping.

clue.text: Feigns when in court? Quite the reverse

indicators.note: one piece sits in another, as the surface says of the word when inside court
this phrase flips the stated containment, so court goes inside when instead

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I arrived'

explanation.surface: Does a person pretend while in a courtroom? The clue then says it is the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface invites putting the 'when' word inside the court word; 'Quite the reverse' tells you to do the opposite.
explanation.definitionFit: To act is to pretend or put on a show, so acts is a synonym for feigns.

clue.text: I invent a new complex treatment for snake bite

indicators.note: complex here suggests letters tangled together, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A boast about devising an elaborate new cure for snake venom.
explanation.definitionFit: Antivenin is an antiserum counteracting venom, the standard treatment after a snake strikes.

clue.text: Hill overlooking Canadian province in the direction of its major city

indicators.note: in a down clue, overlooking means this piece sits above the next

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor
ON is the postal abbreviation for Ontario
to means towards, in the direction of

explanation.surface: A hill looks down on an Ontario landscape facing its biggest city.
explanation.definitionFit: Toronto is the capital and largest city of Ontario, the province the clue mentions.

clue.text: Game character adopts a mood to be feverish

parts.note: RU is rugby union, a common game abbreviation

indicators.note: a character that adopts something takes it in, so letters go inside

parts.note: nature means a person's character or disposition
temper means a mood, as in 'in a good temper'

explanation.surface: A video-game figure takes on a bad mood and seems feverish.
explanation.definitionFit: To run a temperature is the idiom for having a fever, so it means being feverish.

clue.text: Drink twice the specified amount

definitions.meaning: a measure of spirits of two standard shots, as ordered in a bar

explanation.surface: Pour yourself two measures of liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: A spirit measure of two shots is named for being twice as much, which is also the general sense of two times an amount.

clue.text: Single high voltage replacement for storage place

indicators.note: a replacement puts things in new places, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: HV is the standard abbreviation for high voltage

explanation.surface: A single high-voltage unit is swapped in at a storage facility.
explanation.definitionFit: Shelving is a set of shelves, where goods or books are kept, hence a storage place.

clue.text: See stoat, dead and infested with fleas

parts.note: V stands for vide, Latin for see, used in references
ermine is the stoat, especially in its white winter coat
D is the abbreviation for dead, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: Look at this deceased stoat crawling with fleas.
explanation.definitionFit: Vermined means overrun with pests such as fleas or lice, so infested with fleas is an example.

clue.text: Longer river's empty beside Northern town

parts.note: more can mean longer, as in 'stay a little more'
the Cam is the river through Cambridge

indicators.note: empty means the inside letters are removed, leaving the outer ones

explanation.surface: A longer river has run dry beside a northern town.
explanation.definitionFit: Morecambe is a seaside resort town in Lancashire in north-west England.

clue.text: Preserve name on old weaponry

parts.note: to can food is to preserve it in tins

explanation.surface: Keep a name attached to some antique arms.
explanation.definitionFit: Cannon is an old-fashioned collective term for heavy guns, so it means old weaponry.

clue.text: Natural consequence of company register annual return's unknown

parts.note: a roll is a register or list of names
A is an abbreviation for annual
R is an abbreviation for return
y is an unknown quantity in algebra

explanation.surface: A company's annual return to the register has a mystery figure, naturally.
explanation.definitionFit: A corollary is a proposition that follows naturally from another, a natural consequence.

clue.text: Clever lens almost transformed neuron

indicators.note: transformed means changed in form, so the letters are rearranged
almost means the word lens loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A clever lens nearly changes into a brain cell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims LENS to LEN; 'transformed' rearranges CLEVER and LEN together.
explanation.definitionFit: A neuron is a cell carrying impulses in the nervous system, the technical term for this.

clue.text: In France the upper class ultimately defer to the Spanish crown

parts.note: la is the French feminine word for the
U is the label for upper-class usage

indicators.note: ultimately points to the last letter of the word defer

parts.note: el is the Spanish masculine word for the

explanation.surface: French aristocrats finally bow to the Spanish monarchy.
explanation.definitionFit: A laurel wreath was worn as a victor's crown, so the word names that kind of crown.

clue.text: Rubbish steeped in spoiled saki produces fuel from residue

indicators.note: something steeped in a liquid sits within it, so one piece goes inside the other
spoiled means ruined, so the letters of the word saki are rearranged

parts.note: tat is cheap rubbish, junk

explanation.surface: Junk soaked in bad Japanese rice wine produces some fuel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoiled' rearranges the rice wine's name to ASKI; saki is a variant spelling of sake.
explanation.definitionFit: Astatki is a fuel oil made from the residue of petroleum distillation in Russia.

clue.text: He feels repugnance for Northern shirker lolling about

indicators.note: a shirker lolling about is lounging around, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A man is disgusted by a lazy northerner idling around.
explanation.definitionFit: One who shrinks from something recoils in distaste, so a person feeling repugnance is such a one.

clue.text: Southern feller who works hard

definitions.note: a relative clause standing for the noun 'one who works hard'

parts.note: a feller of trees is a logger

explanation.surface: A man from the south who toils diligently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feller' looks like 'fellow' but means one who fells trees.
explanation.definitionFit: A slogger is one who toils steadily and doggedly, a hard worker.

clue.text: Shakespearian shrew loses male in hurricane

indicators.note: the shrew loses something, so letters are removed from her name

parts.note: Katherina is the shrew in Shakespeare's The Taming of the Shrew
he is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: The heroine of a Shakespeare comedy drops her husband during a storm.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurricane Katrina devastated New Orleans in 2005, so the name is an example of a hurricane.

clue.text: 6 playing before Roman censor are musically disconnected

indicators.note: playing here means fooling around with the word from 6 across, so it is rearranged

parts.note: the clue refers to the answer to 6 across, which is acts
Cato the Elder was a famous censor of ancient Rome

explanation.surface: Six performances come before a Roman censor and seem musically choppy.
explanation.walkthrough: '6' points to the 6-across answer; 'playing' rearranges ACTS into STAC.
explanation.definitionFit: Staccato is the musical direction for notes played short and separated, so disconnected.

clue.text: Protestant sect causes Scotsman to lose his head

indicators.note: losing his head means the Scotsman's name drops its first letter

parts.note: Hamish is a typical Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: A religious group makes a Scot go mad.
explanation.definitionFit: The Amish are a conservative Anabaptist group, a Protestant sect living plainly.

clue.text: Young tell it in garbled fashion

indicators.note: speaking in garbled fashion mixes things up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Instructions to a child to relate something in a muddled way.
explanation.definitionFit: Little means small or youthful, as in 'when I was little', so it means young.

clue.text: Mint is mixed with champagne in this crushing device

indicators.note: mixed means blended together, so all these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A cocktail recipe of mint and champagne made in some crushing gadget.
explanation.definitionFit: A stamping machine pounds ore or materials with heavy stamps, so it is a crushing device.

clue.text: Essentially fellow is exceptionally shrewd

indicators.note: essentially means at its core, so the letters lie inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: At heart, the man is unusually astute.
explanation.definitionFit: Being wise means having sound judgement, which is a close synonym for being shrewd.

clue.text: Resolute author

definitions.meaning: tough and robust, able to endure hardship
Thomas ..., the English novelist of Tess of the d'Urbervilles

explanation.surface: A determined writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardy means sturdy and tough, and Thomas Hardy is the Victorian novelist and poet.

clue.text: Bowled a long, ultimately lethal delivery

parts.note: B is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for bowled

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word lethal

explanation.surface: A cricketer sent down a long, deadly delivery.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket each ball bowled is called a delivery, so the two terms are synonyms.
